```python
import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

df = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.lmplot(x='Physical Activity Level', y='Sleep Duration', data=df, 
           hue='BMI Category', ci=None, height=6, aspect=1.6, 
           palette='viridis', scatter_kws={'alpha':0.7})
plt.title('Physical Activity Level vs. Sleep Duration by BMI Category')
plt.xlabel('Physical Activity Level (min/day)')
plt.ylabel('Sleep Duration (hours)')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
